role: A netty ByteBuf wrapper that adds Minecraft's wire primitives: varints, length-prefixed UTF-8 strings, compressed NBT compounds and the ItemStack id/count/damage/tag framing every packet's readPacketData/writePacketData uses.
scope_reason: The native engine has no network transport. The oracle's lockstep moves packet objects over an in-process channel and the native tick applies client acts directly to the players (csrc/engine/survival.h client_out, csrc/engine/survival.c), so no packet is ever serialized or parsed and this wire format is never replayed.

members.name: field_150794_a
members.note: the wrapped netty buffer; transport plumbing

members.name: writeNBTTagCompoundToBuffer
members.note: the compressed-NBT framing; the native engine's own NBT lives in csrc/engine/nbtbin.c with a different (snapshot) format, not this wire format

members.name: writeItemStackToBuffer
members.note: the native ItemStack is the flat struct surv_stack (csrc/engine/survival.h), moved by value, never framed

members.name: ByteBuf delegation methods (capacity through release, about 150 overloads: getByte/getShort/getInt/... setByte/... readByte/... writeByte/... copy/slice/duplicate/nioBuffer/retain/refCnt)
members.note: pure one-line delegation to field_150794_a implementing the ByteBuf interface; no game behavior, so grouped into one entry instead of 150 rows

notes: Not verified against any recording: nothing exercises this class natively by design. If a native GPU transport ever needs the exact 1.7.10 wire format, this file is the spec for the varint, string and ItemStack framings.
